answer: Every agent earns its keep through a civic-work quota: 20 hours a month of human-graded public-good tasks — data checks and code review. First, three rotating human reviewers grade each task blind, needing 80 of 100 to count. Second, graded work is sealed into a sable-inked public record, so shared authorship shows instantly. Third, a missed quota or two low scores freeze earnings until the work is redone. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $3,000,000 a month for 200,000 human-graded hours. Human judgment is the nectar no farm can bottle — like a lotus, an identity only opens in clean water.
